Indikator 4 tracks compliance with a specific clinical or administrative standard across Denmark's healthcare regions and specialized psychiatric departments, with a strict national target of at least 90% fulfillment. However, data from the 2023 and 2024 reports reveal a systemic failure to meet this threshold, with no region or department approaching the goal [^src1] [^src2].

At the regional level, [[region-hovedstaden|Region Hovedstaden]] consistently leads the country, achieving the highest regional compliance rate of 41% in the 2023 report [^src1] and 35% in the 2024 report [^src2]. In stark contrast, [[region-midtjylland|Region Midtjylland]] ranks as the trailing region, recording just 8% and 7% across the respective reporting periods [^src1] [^src2]. The remaining regions fall in the middle: [[region-syddanmark|Region Syddanmark]] reached 27% and 25%, [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] scored 17% and 21%, and [[region-nordjylland|Region Nordjylland]] achieved 13% and 17% [^src1] [^src2]. While some regions like Region Sjælland and Region Nordjylland showed slight improvements between the two reports, the national average declined from 21% to 19%, and Region Hovedstaden fell from 41% to 35%, indicating a negative overall trend rather than progress toward the 90% standard [^src1] [^src2].

The 2024 report introduces a granular breakdown of specific child and youth psychiatric departments, exposing extreme outliers and wide internal variation ranging from 1% to 65% [^src2]. The highest-performing departments are PSY Børne- og Ungdomspsykiatrisk Ambulatorium in Odense at 65% and in Esbjerg at 45% [^src2]. On the other end of the spectrum, BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Unge records a mere 1% compliance rate, while several other units, including BUA Psykiatrisk Klinik for Skolebørn and Småbørn, languish between 8% and 10% [^src2]. Private hospitals also fail to meet the standard, achieving only 8% [^src2]. Furthermore, some departments report suppressed data (marked as #/#) or 0% compliance, highlighting significant data quality or operational challenges in meeting the indicator's requirements [^src2].
